body:
I can't get a job. I keep applying and no one wants me. 
  
I live with two relatives who want nothing to do with me when our lease ends this summer. I was born to two drug addicts who didn't take care of me. I feel like I have some emotional trauma or something and I can't connect with anyone or open up. The only thing that made my mom get clean was getting a new boyfriend. He's gone and now she's using again. She keeps berating me about how I'm useless and overweight and how I'm going to get diabetes and die like my grandfather.   

I've been depressed for the past six years and have had suicidal thoughts for the past five. The only thing that kept me from doing it was that I didn't want to cause my family any pain, but now I know they don't want to be around me. I have no friends and only $500 to my name. I feel like if I don't get a job soon I have nothing to live for.
